gw_exitsubs.add.max: There are already {n} subscriptions — no more can be added.
gw_exitsubs.add.pinned: The server’s certificate is self-signed — its fingerprint is saved (SHA-256 {fp}…): if it changes, the subscription will have to be added again.
gw_exitsubs.all_skipped: The subscription has {n} key, but xray won’t accept it — {why}. Pool keys left unchanged.|The subscription has {n} keys, but xray won’t accept any of them — {why}. Pool keys left unchanged.
gw_exitsubs.busy: Subscriptions are being refreshed elsewhere (the timer, the panel or the menu) — try again in a minute.
gw_exitsubs.delete.kept: ; its keys stay in the pool as added by hand.
gw_exitsubs.empty: The subscription is empty — it has no keys. Pool keys left unchanged.
gw_exitsubs.html: The server sent a web page instead of a subscription — check the link. Pool keys left unchanged.
gw_exitsubs.name: subscription {n}
gw_exitsubs.no_keys: The subscription returned no keys (expected VPN keys: vless, hy2, ss, trojan, vmess, vpn://, amneziawg:// or .conf text). Pool keys left unchanged.
gw_exitsubs.not_found: No such subscription: {ref} (list: kaskadctl gw exit-sub list).
gw_exitsubs.note.bare: goAmnezia subscription link without a format — using “all.vpn”
gw_exitsubs.note.clash: Kaskad can’t read the Clash profile ({suffix}) — using “all.vpn” of the same subscription
gw_exitsubs.note.txt: “all.txt” has the same keys as “all.vpn”: using “all.vpn” of the same subscription
gw_exitsubs.pool_busy: The key pool is being changed elsewhere (the web panel or the menu) — try again in a minute.
gw_exitsubs.pool_churn: The key pool keeps changing (another window) — try again in a minute.
gw_exitsubs.pool_full: The pool already has the maximum number of keys ({max}).
gw_exitsubs.restore.done: Keys of subscription “{name}” removed by hand are back. {result}
gw_exitsubs.restore.later: Subscription “{name}” no longer excludes keys, but it didn’t download now — they’ll come back with the next refresh. {result}
gw_exitsubs.restore.none: Subscription “{name}” has no keys removed by hand. {result}
gw_exitsubs.result.dups_many: these keys are already in the pool: {list}
gw_exitsubs.result.full: Pool limit ({max} keys): {n} didn’t fit — delete keys you don’t need.
gw_exitsubs.result.skipped: Keys skipped: {n} — {why}; the rest were applied.
gw_exitsubs.result.updated: {name}: updated {n} (a new name or parameters of the key) — the exits, their labels and the routes of the devices are kept (keys in the subscription: {count}).
gw_exitsubs.result.updated_too: Updated {n} (a new name or parameters of the key) — the exits, their labels and the routes of the devices are kept.
gw_exitsubs.skip.bad_addr: the client address in the AmneziaWG key is outside private networks or taken by a network of this server — the key won’t do, ask for a new one
gw_exitsubs.skip.bad_pin: the certificate fingerprint (pcs) isn’t a SHA-256
gw_exitsubs.skip.dup_endpoint: a second Hysteria2 key at the same server address and port
gw_exitsubs.skip.insecure: the certificate check is off (allowInsecure) and there’s no certificate fingerprint (pcs) — add the key by hand to pin its fingerprint
gw_exitsubs.skip.no_tls: no TLS to a public address
gw_exitsubs.skip.other: xray won’t accept such a key
gw_exitsubs.skip.weak_cipher: no encryption or a weak cipher
gw_exitsubs.skip.xray_refused: this version of xray doesn’t accept such a key
gw_exitsubs.skip.xray_unchecked: xray didn’t answer in time — the key will be checked on the next refresh
gw_exitsubs.state.dups: ; duplicates skipped: {n} (the key is already in the pool)
gw_exitsubs.state.error_new: not refreshed for less than an hour: {err}
gw_exitsubs.twin_failed: The routes of the copy the subscription dropped did not move to “{name}”: {error}
gw_exitsubs.twin_unfit: The routes of the copy the subscription dropped did not move to “{name}”: it is off for the gateway or cannot work — choose an exit for them yourself.
gw_exitsubs.notls_kept: The key “{name}” without TLS is kept as it was: the subscription gives it unencrypted to a public address — new keys like it are not taken. Ask the provider for a key with TLS or REALITY.
gw_exitsubs.url_bad: That’s not a subscription link: one line http(s)://… without spaces.
gw_exitsubs.url_scheme: A subscription is an http:// or https:// link with a server address.
gw_exitsubs.yaml: This is a Clash (mihomo) profile — Kaskad can’t read it: use a subscription with VPN keys (vless, hy2, ss, trojan, vmess, vpn://; in goAmnezia — the “all.vpn” link). Pool keys left unchanged.
gw_exitsubs.skip.gw_net: the client address in the AmneziaWG key falls within the gateway network of this server {net} — move the gateway of one of the servers to another network (in the panel: Settings › Gateway › Gateway network); the devices of the gateway you move will need new keys
gw_exitsubs.skip.self_ep: the server address in the key points to this server — the key won’t do, ask for a new one
gw_exitsubs.result.standby_group: Subscription “{sub}”: new key “{key}” was put on standby in group “{group}” — confirm it in Exits.
gw_exitsubs.result.standby: Subscription “{sub}”: new key “{key}” was put on standby among the domestic exits — confirm it in Exits.
gw_exitsubs.result.standby_n_group: Subscription “{sub}”: new keys ({n}) were put on standby in group “{group}” — confirm each one in Exits.
gw_exitsubs.result.standby_n: Subscription “{sub}”: new keys ({n}) were put on standby among the domestic exits — confirm each one in Exits.
